card.name: Digits inside numbers and Quranic names
card.fires_on: A piece in the middle of a number, usually a digit inside a patient count or page range, such as the 3 in 22/23. Also partway through a transliterated Surah name in a Quran citation.

modes.description: A single digit in the middle of a patient fraction, total, or page range.

modes.label: Surah name in citation
modes.description: The ending piece of a transliterated Surah name inside a Quran reference.
